answer: For agents processing lantern sensor data, pay once per requester-signed job ID, with a fixed fee independent of worker count. Each job specifies a thread of readings and requires a verifiable computation proof; the payment contract marks its ID spent. A ripple of aliases cannot redeem one result twice. Extra revenue requires completing extra authorized jobs and paying their computation cost. This assumes sound proofs and a requester that does not mint paid jobs for its own aliases.
